name: retouch
description: Edit a running Vite + React site in place - text, position, size, rotation, colour, deletion - and save the changes back to the source code. No AI in the edit path.

retouchNotes.vite: Not a dependency: Retouch drives the project's own Vite, resolved from the project.
retouchNotes.@anthropic-ai/sdk: Optional, only for `retouch map`. Install it here by hand if you want that command.
